Class GainFood

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.model.entities.card.effects.instant.CardEffectInstant
it.polimi.ingsw.model.entities.card.effects.instant.GainFood
public class GainFood extends CardEffectInstant
An instant effect that grants food to the owning player.

The exact gain rule is determined by gainFoodType: it may award a flat amount, an amount based on the number of cards of a given type in the player's village, or an amount based on completed crafter symbol sets. The foodAmount field carries the base parameter used by the rule.
